same_batches_same_order.method: the train and held-out streams are pure functions of (train_seed, split, corpus_id, tokenizer_sha256, l, batch) and take no arm and no seed argument, so every arm and every seed consumes the same windows in the same order; the first N windows of each stream are hashed here and the corpus/config identity they were derived from is recorded
same_batches_same_order.scope: certifies that the data pipeline is arm-independent and seed-independent for the recorded corpus/config; it is not an observation of the finished training loop

paired_init_seeds.method: both arms are rebuilt with the same seed through the runner's own `apply_init_policy` and their shared (non-sublayer-1) parameters are compared bitwise; the generator-drawn tensors are counted separately from the constant-filled ones (LayerNorm gains/biases)
paired_init_seeds.scope: certifies the initialisation of the shared parameters; sublayer-1 is arm-specific by construction and is not expected to match
